text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit parking at all times on the east side of St. Lucie Drive, between Gulfstream Road and a point 32 metres south. The proposed prohibition is a result of a meeting with the Ward Councillor to address concerns regarding excessive and long-term parking on the east side of St. Lucie Drive, south of Gulfstream Road.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of St. Lucie Drive, between Gulfstream Road and a point 32 metres south.
